title: Buying in Japan? Check borrowing eligibility first
summary: A property search and a mortgage application raise different questions. Start with the product’s borrower and property conditions.

takeaways.text: Flat35 requires Japanese nationality or qualifying Japanese permanent-residence status.

sections.heading: Residence status matters
sections.text: JHF lists Japanese nationals, permanent residents and special permanent residents as eligible nationality/residence categories for Flat35. Other underwriting conditions still apply.

sections.heading: Read this narrowly
sections.text: This is a condition of Flat35, not a claim that all lenders have identical rules. Singapore permanent residence does not establish Japanese permanent residence. Ask the intended lender about your own status and documentation before budgeting around a loan.
